about: The Scribble Board (spec/v2.md section 10). points: packed points of a stroke in hex and what they hold, [x, y, t, force, azimuth, altitude] per point, x and y in 1/16 board unit. points_refused: packed bytes no reader takes. items: payloads of board items; a reader that decodes and encodes one gets the same text; file_ids is what the envelope's header lists. items_with_unknown_fields: payloads with fields no reader knows, or without schema_version, that read like the one named in same_as. items_refused, snapshots_refused: with the code of the refusal. history: board items in one order of arrival (sender in hex, envelope number, payload); applied in any order that keeps each sender's own order they give the board whose snapshot file, taken at frontier, is snapshot.

items_refused.why: a shape that names its own id
a stroke with a note's field
points with a point cut short
points whose base64url has bits left over
a layer that is no whole number
a number with a leading zero
a whole number written with a fraction
a whole number written with an exponent
a layer too small to tell from 0
a stroke with a note's field set to null
a field of its own set to null
an erase with strokes set to null
a file key written with an escape
a key twice in a field no reader knows

points_refused.why: a point that ends after x
a point without altitude in a stroke with tilt

snapshots_refused.why: a shape of a writer the frontier does not name
a shape of an unknown tool
a writer twice in the frontier
an erased shape that the frontier covers
a move kept for a shape that the frontier covers
a move kept for an erased shape
